description.value:
“Yesod fell. The world remembered old names. You answered.”

Oldenborn (Stormborn Nomad). Your place-soul is a weather front. You are the caravan memory of every tribe that crossed the ash squalls and came out the other side. When you walk, the wind remembers that you used to be the reason it had a name.

Traits

  • Creature Type. Humanoid (Fey, Stormborn).
  • Size. Medium.
  • Speed. 6 squares.
  • Attributes. Oldenborn does not grant fixed attribute bonuses; your background handles increases. Your heritage leans toward Intrigue or Soul in fiction and through Tier powers.

Oldenborn Core

At character creation you gain Old Memory, Old Flesh (Dream-Flesh, Old Paths, Veil-Sight, You Are Remembered) from the Oldenborn ancestry.

Stormborn Nomad Traits

  • Storm-Legs. You reroll the lowest die on Athletics checks made in wind, rain or ash-fall, and on checks to keep your footing on a moving vehicle or rig.
  • Weatherwise. Your Tier I power: 12-hour weather foresight within one hex and Wind-Read, a reaction that halves weather damage.

Stormborn Tier Powers

You gain Weatherwise at creation, then Ward of the Gale at Initiation 5, Nomad Networks at Initiation 11 and Skywalker at Initiation 17.

Domain Edge

  • Domain Edge. Your Domain gains +20 Non-Lethal marks and +20 Faith marks at campaign start.

Oldenborn.

“You are not an elf. You are the memory of a place that learned to walk again.”

Dream-Flesh. You do not sleep. When you rest, you drift into Yesod—symbolic memory-space—unless you choose otherwise. You are immune to magical sleep, and you can always tell when a dream, illusion, or constructed reality is present.

Old Memory, Old Paths. You reroll the lowest die on checks to interpret ruins, follow ley-lines, identify altered terrain, and sense metaphysical instability. You always know if a place feels remembered, abandoned, or contested (the GM answers vaguely).

Veil-Sight. You perceive the presence of spirits, ghosts, Spark echoes, and noospheric constructs. This grants awareness, not perfect sight.

You Are Remembered. When you first meet a community, the GM chooses (or rolls) whether you are met with reverence, fear, or familiarity. It’s never neutral.

description.value:
"The future is just memory pointed the other way."

The Dreamwalker reads the Tree and works manifestations — and that work is the fuel. You run on Surge like everyone, but yours arrives when you cast a manifestation (bank +1, max +2/round).

The Oracle (spent via Surge)

  • Omen (1) — you or an ally saw the thread coming: banks a reroll-lowest.
  • Dream Ward (2) — an ally drifts into a protective dreamstate: DR + a reroll.
  • Shared Dream (3) — allies within 6 squares bank a reroll and draw 1 Clarity (refuels their casting).
  • Reality Hack (5) — rewrite the moment: the party banks a reroll and one enemy rolls its next attack rolling 3d10 and keeping the lowest 2.

The Dream-Cache endures — bank a manifestation between scenes, deploy it next scene without paying Clarity. And the oracle's quiet work stays out of combat: Dream-Sense still reads a hex's Sephirah, and you still put your one question to the Great Work (Initiate of the Great Work) for a true answer.

description.value:
Oneiric Pulse. Close your eyes. The future blinks first.

  • Your consciousness intermittently echoes ahead of your physical movement, granting subtle foresight.
  • You can feel metaphysical anomalies ‘warming up’ before they manifest.

Lucid Step. You exist at a slight angle to normal motion. When danger arrives, you are already half-in the place you meant to go.

  • You gain +1 to Intrigue check.
  • Once per Soma Break, when you take damage you can reduce the total by an amount equal to your tier.

Initiate of the Great Work. Sleep is a meeting place, not a refuge.

  • Once per Soma Break, you may choose to reroll the lowest die on an Insight (Soul) checks, a Soul check, or a Presence check as you call upon the Dream for guidance.
  • You may ask the Dream one question each Soma Break—an omen, a vector, or a hidden connection. The Dream does not lie, but neither is it always literal.

Tier 1 — Oneiric Reservoir. Your Clarity maximum is +2. On Soma Break you recover Clarity equal to your tier instead of the flat default. Detect Spark resonance in adjacent hexes (carryover).

Discipline (passive): Clarity max +2. Skill rank +1 in Perception and Faith.

items.name: Trance of the Sapphire Gate (Bad Eden)

description.value:
"Every threshold is also a doorway."

Mode: Transitional

The Sapphire Gate treats walls as suggestions and distance as paperwork. Your Surge spends are repositioning made real — carrying allies clear, stepping through a threshold for the tactical edge, holding the line steady at the door.

Trance (spent via Surge)

  • Gate-Touched (1) — carry an ally through to safety: DR + a freed reaction.
  • Sapphire Step (2) — you and an ally step through and out elsewhere: each banks a reroll + a freed reaction.
  • Gate Held Open (3) — allies within 6 squares bank a reroll and gain DR (the threshold steadies them).

Out-of-combat: Gate Anchor, Sapphire Lucidity, Dream Relay, Bright Hypnopomp, Sapphire Conduction and Blue Meridian remain the strategic flourishes.

“The sky is a language. You were the first to learn the punctuation.”

Weatherwise. You always know the upcoming weather for the next 12 hours within one hex (five miles), even underground. You reroll the lowest die on checks against weather effects (extreme cold, extreme heat, wind, lightning).

Wind-Read (1/Soma Break). When you would take lightning, thunder, or thermal damage, you may use your reaction to halve it. The wind shifts as you do.

Ash-Walker. You ignore difficult terrain caused by snow, ash, dust, sand, or shifting earth.

⟁ Per-Use Ability — Wind-Read Recovery: 1/Soma Break · Action: Reaction (on weather damage) — an Offer card appears when it applies · Weatherwise is always on. Halve incoming lightning, thunder or thermal damage as a reaction. Weather foresight for 12 hours within one hex; reroll the lowest die on defense checks against weather.

Dream-Sense. Your dreams are not private—they are diagnostic readouts of the world's hidden structure.

  • You gain a subtle, constant awareness of emotional, moral, and metaphysical gradients in your environment.
  • You always sense Sephirothic or Qliphothic tilt in a hex you enter.
  • Your Spark sensitivity is higher than most; your dreams react to metaphysical disturbances long before waking senses do.

Bladed Tempo

Your weapons are punctuation.

Rules

When you hit with a melee weapon attack, you may immediately draw or stow a weapon, or shift 1 square without provoking reaction strikes.

✍ Table rule.

Step sideways, see which kind of dream waits.

Once per turn, when your Domain generates or receives a Spark Lead (a clue, ping, or emergent phenomenon pointing toward a Spark), you may spend 10 Soft Power marks to perform a Sapphire Lucidity check.

  • You immediately learn whether the next Spark is Conceptual, Vestigial, or Animate.
  • This insight cannot reveal power level, danger tier, or location—only the metaphysical class of the Spark.

This is not divination. It’s memory from the world-that-was.

Some couriers walk; some dream their routes.

While you are asleep or in a dream state (magical or mundane), you may send short messages (up to 12 words) to up to tier allies who are:

  • In Hexes adjacent to your own, and
  • Marked as Gate Anchors by you at any previous time.

Allies receive these messages as sudden waking impressions or dream-echoes. They may send one brief reply (12 words) which you hear as though whispered across a hallway of light.

Adaptive Defense

Defense is not denial. It is management.

Rules

When you are hit by an attack you can see, you may use your reaction to reduce the damage by an amount equal to your rank bonus + your Violence or Intrigue value (your choice).

🃏 Card — click ▶ when you are hit: it shows the reduction (rank bonus + Violence or Intrigue).

Wake bearing good news from the other side.

When you finish a Soma Break, choose up to tier allies who rested with you.

  • They each gain temporary Integrity equal to your tier.
  • They may each remove the Shaken condition if they are suffering from it.

You return from dreams carrying a little morning light for everyone.

description.value:
Occult Association (Bad Eden): Tarot Mage.

“The future is rude. I read it anyway.”

Tarot Mages do not predict the future. They interrogate it.

They treat fate like a deck: shuffled by chaos, cut by will, and stacked by anyone reckless enough to pay the price. Where other occult traditions pursue the Great Work through doctrine, continuity, or purification, the Tarot Mage pursues it through timing. The right pressure, at the right instant, can do what a thousand sincere speeches cannot.

To a Tarot Mage, the Great Work is not just about choosing well. It is about choosing at the moment that matters.

How Tarot Mages pursue the Great Work:

  • By reading currents before Scenarios begin
  • By turning uncertainty into leverage
  • By making coincidence behave like a trained animal
  • By treating timing as a resource as real as OP

Resonance: Keter / Signal / Probability — possibility, timing, pattern emergence, and the dangerous urge to edit what has not happened yet.

Tell-tales: shuffles anything that can be shuffled — cards, choices, people.

Faction Effect (Passive):

  • +1 to your Domain's Intrigue Domain rolls

Cost Principle: fate does not like fingerprints. Expect backlash, strange timing, narrative inversion, and consequences that arrive sideways when you push probability too hard.

Domain edge: Your Domain earns +10 Intrigue marks each turn while you serve it.
